title: Are three radiations three processes?
status: source-and-code audit; visual test conditions are editorial thought experiments, not audience data
source_scope: Gurdjieff’s cosmology as reported by P. D. Ouspensky, organic life as an organ of reception and radiation.

textual_sources.label: Ouspensky, In Search of the Miraculous — organic life passages
Gurdjieff Foundation of Hawaii — attributed excerpts

claims.statement: Terrestrial organic life mediates planetary influences to the Earth.
Organic life emits differentiated radiations toward Sun, planets, and Moon; their requirements differ.
The Moon is maintained by energies associated with terrestrial organic life.

inward.role: organic life mediates planetary influences toward Earth

outgoing.role: organic life radiates to distinct recipients
outgoing.visual_operation: periodic marks move along quadratic paths toward a recipient

channels.name: Moonward stream
channels.note: Gold dots are an invented identifier, not sourced material properties.

channels.name: Sunward stream
channels.note: Purple squares are an invented identifier, not sourced material properties.

channels.name: Planetward stream
channels.note: Blue rings are an invented identifier, not sourced material properties.

encoding.rate_units: Fraction of one drawn path per second in the implemented scene; not sourced cosmic frequency.

operations.label: Current marks
operations.question: Do distinct colors/shapes imply different mechanics beyond different recipient categories?

operations.label: Uniform glyphs
operations.changes: All three outgoing streams use the same neutral glyph
operations.question: Which information disappears when the streams look identical? Can destination labels still identify the three recipients?

operations.label: Swap symbols
operations.preserves: G03 directed relationships and visible existence of three differing kinds
operations.changes: Only the assignment of color and shape to the recipients
operations.question: Does the meaning of G03 change when the appearance-to-recipient mapping is permuted?

findings.conclusion: Three distinct recipient categories and source-asserted kinds are justified by G03.
findings.limit: The text does not specify physical or dynamic parameters for those kinds.

findings.conclusion: Current outputs differ primarily by glyph, color, destination, and arbitrary procedural rate.
findings.limit: Same underlying visual operation (repeated marker propagation) is used for all.

findings.conclusion: Changing glyph assignment cannot change the underlying lore claim.
findings.limit: Arbitrariness of chosen symbols does not make differentiation itself arbitrary.

findings.conclusion: Uniform glyphs preserve the three directed relations but no longer encode their qualitative difference without text.
findings.limit: This does not establish how real viewers decode a scene.

findings.conclusion: Current scene does not depict distinct mechanisms of reception, absorption, metabolism, or support at destinations.
findings.limit: Do not introduce invented receiver behaviors solely to make it look more scientific.

findings.conclusion: G02 reception/mediation and G03 radiation are role-distinct in the source but share a particle-flow idiom visually.
findings.limit: An evocative physical-looking flow is allowed; the question is whether it communicates the important role distinction.

findings.conclusion: Moonward arrival is not a representation of the stronger continuing-maintenance claim G04.
findings.limit: Sustenance would require a separate sourced role and visual treatment.

recommended_actions: Keep a consistent, intentionally arbitrary category code for G03 when the film needs to show that requirements differ; mark it as a category cue, not a physical taxonomy.
Do not advertise three different physical processes until a source specifies different processes or the work declares them explicitly as artistic analogies.
Equalize or remove procedural speed differences where they could imply unsupported doctrine; the source gives no comparative rates.
Improve G02 by showing local organism- or surface-specific receptive differences: Ouspensky explicitly contrasts grass-covered areas and human gatherings.
Retain named recipients and a semantically accurate research key; do not restore an intrusive permanent film legend.
Keep G04 as context only until a separately justified visual conveys ongoing nourishment or maintenance.
limitations: No audience comprehension study was performed.
The source describes different kinds of radiation, but not their physical identities, rhythms, colors, velocities or receiver-level mechanisms.
The visual exercise varies representation, not the truth of the doctrinal propositions.
This is a backstage design instrument, not an audience-facing theology film.
